933: If a person keeps betting on the rolling dice without stopping, their money and everything it brings in will leave them and go to others.
936: People who fall under gambling, which is like the goddess of bad luck, will never even fill their stomachs, and they will suffer many troubles.
943: Once your last meal is digested, eat only the right amount. That is the way to keep the body you were given going for a long time.
951: Only people born into a good family naturally have these two together: doing what is right and feeling shame at doing wrong.
967: It is better to be called a person who has lost everything than to live by running after people who do not respect you.
968: When your honor and greatness are being destroyed, why hold on to life just to feed your body? Is that a medicine that will let you live forever?
977: When honor and high position come to people of poor character, it only makes them act in ways that go beyond all limits.
982: The real goodness of good people is the goodness of their character. No other kind of goodness counts as real goodness at all.
989: People who are called the ocean (the deep, steady home) of perfect character will not change, even if the whole world comes to an end.
1023: When a person decides, 'I will lift up my family,' even the gods tuck in their clothes, ready for work, and hurry ahead to help.
1050: If very poor people do not fully give up worldly life, they become like death to other people's salt and rice-water (thin rice soup), only eating up what others have.
1063: Nothing is harsher than the idea that you can end the pain of being poor by begging instead of working.
